What do you want to be?
I want to be a doctor.
What did you do last night?

units.title: 現在進行式挑戰
units.sourceNote: 使用者補充練習清單；非出版社逐課教材

words.explanation: Look! 提醒正在發生的動作：he + is + 動詞-ing。
words.fullSentence: Look! He is reading a book.

words.explanation: they 用 are，再接動詞-ing。
words.fullSentence: Listen! They are singing in the classroom.

words.explanation: now 表示現在正在做：they are dancing。
words.fullSentence: They are dancing now.

words.explanation: I 的 be 動詞用 am。
words.fullSentence: I am doing my homework now.

words.explanation: she 用 is washing 表示正在洗。
words.fullSentence: She is washing the dishes now.

units.title: 現在簡單式挑戰
units.sourceNote: 使用者補充練習清單；非出版社逐課教材

words.zh: I ___ up at seven every day.
words.prompt: I ___ up at seven every day.
words.explanation: 日常習慣用現在簡單式；I 接 get。
words.fullSentence: I get up at seven every day.

words.explanation: 現在簡單式第三人稱單數：like 加 s。
words.fullSentence: She likes apples.

words.zh: He usually ___ to school by bus.
words.prompt: He usually ___ to school by bus.
words.explanation: he 是第三人稱單數；go 改為 goes。
words.fullSentence: He usually goes to school by bus.

words.explanation: 主詞 you 的一般動詞問句用 Do。
words.fullSentence: Do you like monkeys?

words.explanation: your father 是第三人稱單數，問句用 does。
words.fullSentence: What does your father do?

units.title: 過去簡單式挑戰
units.sourceNote: 使用者補充練習清單；非出版社逐課教材

words.explanation: yesterday 指過去，go 的過去式是 went。
words.fullSentence: We went to the zoo yesterday.

words.explanation: last week 指過去，he 搭配 was。
words.fullSentence: He was sick last week.

words.explanation: last night 指過去；clean 加 ed。
words.fullSentence: I cleaned my room last night.

words.explanation: did 後面的主要動詞用原形 go。
words.fullSentence: Where did you go yesterday?

words.explanation: did 問句後用原形 do。
words.fullSentence: What did you do last night?

units.title: 易混淆搭配挑戰
units.sourceNote: 使用者補充練習清單；非出版社逐課教材

words.explanation: 一般活動用語中，play + 球類不加冠詞。
words.fullSentence: play basketball

words.explanation: 這裡練習常見搭配 play the piano。
words.fullSentence: play the piano

words.explanation: 表示日常吃早餐時用 have breakfast。
words.fullSentence: have breakfast

words.explanation: home 在 go home 中作副詞，不加 to。
words.fullSentence: go home

words.explanation: 常見搭配是 at home。
words.fullSentence: at home

words.explanation: 表示看電視這個活動時用 watch TV。
words.fullSentence: watch TV

words.explanation: 交通方式：by bus。
words.fullSentence: We can go there by bus.

words.explanation: 步行是 on foot。
words.fullSentence: We can go there on foot.

units.title: 生活句型挑戰
units.sourceNote: 使用者補充練習清單；非出版社逐課教材

words.explanation: 單數 the ball 用 is。
words.fullSentence: The ball is under the desk.

words.explanation: 複數 the books 用 are。
words.fullSentence: The books are on the chair.

words.explanation: can 後面接原形動詞。
words.fullSentence: Can you swim?

words.explanation: want to be + 職業：想成為……。
words.fullSentence: I want to be a doctor.

words.explanation: 請求句用原形 Give；give me a hand 是幫我個忙。
words.fullSentence: Give me a hand, please.
